title: Income can change; preparation helps
label: Clearly identified as an education edition, never as news.
facts: No statistics; arithmetic illustrations only, with assumptions stated.

captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Income can change; preparation helps

Jobs change, hours change and industries change. Few incomes are guaranteed for a lifetime.

Preparation can mean a buffer, up-to-date skills, knowing your entitlements and understanding your fixed costs.

None of this needs a large income to start. It needs attention and time.

Financial awareness is about being ready for change, not fearing it.

Preparing for change means planning ahead, long before it arrives.

Are you financially ready for tomorrow?

Being ready is built steadily, not in a rush.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.

#TwoMarketLedger #TMLEducation #AreYouFinanciallyReady #FinancialLiteracy

For information and education only. Not financial advice.
